text:
Maria Chen: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing an 'excavation' playbook for long-lived tech debt in the enrichment/controlplane path. TL;DR: slice by outward surface, extract low-cohesion modules behind adapters, use contract-first cutovers and guarded rollouts. checklist below — feedback?

Jason Patel: +1 on contract-first. main worry: shared DB migrations and cross-tenant data ownership.

Lee Nguyen: Agree. For DB we should add a read-only shim during cutover and a dual-write window only for vetted tenants. keeps rollback simple.

Anya K: Can we quantify spike time and rollback latency? Also want explicit telemetry hooks per slice (error budget + regression gates).

Maria Chen: Good call. Proposed spike scope in checklist. Quick checklist (high level):
1) Identify minimal public surface (API/route) to keep stable.
2) Design adapter facade (thin proxy) that maps old contract -> new service.
3) Add feature flag + canary routing for 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100%.
4) Telemetry: per-route latency / error / token-cost deltas, and prompt-level eval hooks.
5) DB plan: read-shim -> dual-write opt-in -> backfill -> cut primary.
6) Rollback: route switch + toggled feature flag, and a pre-burn checkpoint snapshot for backfill reversals.
7) Post-cut: 2w monitoring hold, then deprecate adapter.

Maria Chen: Minimal config snippet for the canary route (pseudo):
```
route: /enrich/v1/score
canary:
  policy: header("x-tenant-group") == "pilot"
  weight: 5%
fallback: old-enricher
metrics: [latency_p95, error_rate, token_delta]
```

Jason Patel: That config looks sane. For dual-write we need a data ownership ticket. i'll open one and propose schema migration window. @Anya K can you own telemetry gating?

Anya K: I can own gating. I'll add eval prompt sets and error-alert thresholds. we should capture per-prompt qual metrics, not just errors.

Lee Nguyen: Ops note: make sure autoscaler SLOs are adjusted for canary tail-latency. small traffic spikes + caching warms can affect p99.

Maria Chen: Good catch. We'll add a warmup stage: pre-warm KV cache with historical prefixes and run a synthetic workload for 30m before canary.

deploy-bot: created issue ARCH-2345: "service excavation spike: enrichment extractor" — https://tracker/ARCH-2345

Jason Patel: I'll take the spike (2w). plan: week1 design + infra spike, week2 run canaries + telemetry.

Anya K: I'll prepare eval prompts and dashboards this week. linking /runbook/enrichment-excavation when ready.

Lee Nguyen: I'll draft DB dual-write runbook and the read-shim implementation notes.

Maria Chen: Awesome. Action items: Jason (spike), Anya (telemetry gating), Lee (DB runbook). We meet Tues 10am to sync. If no objections, start Monday. :thumbsup:

Jason Patel: no objections. starting Monday. :party_parrot:

Anya K: ack

Lee Nguyen: ack

Maria Chen: Closing thread — will post RFC addendum with exact API contracts and the canary gating thresholds before EOD Fri.
